description: Put the customer's logo (and up to 2 text lines) on a cup. Returns design_id, design_version, an artwork check (preflight) and a mockup_url. Upload the customer's own file as base64 (PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF, up to 25 MB). Partner agent keys may pass an idempotency_key so a retry does not make a second design.

colour.description: A colour slug from list_cups for that cup

coverage.description: Print coverage offered on that cup (list_cups)

wrap_height.description: full_wrap on a cup with grip ribs (20oz Ringneck, 16oz Pint): above_ribs (default, the ribs stay the cup colour) or to_base (over the ribs)

name: create_design
